title: स्वास्नीमान्छे नाटकमा आमूल नारीवाद {Radical feminism in Swasnimanche play}
nepali: बालकृष्ण समको स्वास्नीमान्छे नाटकमा नारी पात्रको केन्द्रीयता रहेको छ । यस नाटकको प्रमुख भूमिकामा पनि नारी पात्रहरू नै रहेका छन् । ती नारी पात्रहरू पितृसत्तात्मक उत्पीडनको पृष्ठभूमिबाट उठेर त्यसप्रति अत्यन्त विद्रोही पनि देखिएका छन् । त्यसैले उनीहरूले नारीराज्य खडा गरेर पुरुषलाई दोस्रो स्थानमा राखेका छन् । यति मात्र होइन, उनीहरू पुरुषको भाव परिवर्तन गरेर उनीहरूमा नारी गुण प्रत्यारोपण गर्न समेत उद्दत देखिएका छन् । यसै सन्दर्भमा प्रस्तुत अनुसन्धानात्मक लेख तयार पारिएको हो । यसमा नारीवादी सैद्धान्तिक मान्यताअन्तर्गत आमूल नारीवादी चिन्तनका आधारमा स्वास्नीमान्छे नाटकको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । आमूल नारीवादी मान्यताले नारीउत्पीडनको प्रमुख कारक तत्त्वका रूपमा पितृसत्तालाई मानेको छ । यसमा आमूल नारीवादी मान्यताअन्तर्गत पितृसत्तात्मक उत्पीडन एवम् नारीविद्रोहका आधारहरू प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ । यसै आधारमा स्वास्नीमान्छे नाटकका नारी पात्रहरूले झेलेका उत्पीडन तथा सोही उत्पीडनको पृष्ठभूमिबाट उनीहरूले गरेको विद्रोहको निरूपण प्रस्तुत लेखमा गरिएको छ । स्वास्नीमान्छे नाटकमा पितृसत्तात्मक उत्पीडनका केकस्ता सन्दर्भहरू छन् र सो नाटकमा आमूल नारीवादी विचारको अभिव्यक्ति कसरी गरिएको छ भन्ने समस्याको प्राज्ञिक समाधान खोज्नु यस लेखको उद्देश्य रहेको छ । यो लेख साहित्यिक भएको हुनाले यसमा सोहीअनुरूप पुस्तकालयीय कार्यबाट सामग्री सङ्कलन गरी विश्लेषणात्मक विधिबाट तिनको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । स्वास्नीमान्छे नाटकको सामाजिक परिवेशको आरम्भमा पितृसत्तात्मक उत्पीडनको प्रस्तुति गरिएको र तत्पश्चात् विद्रोही र पहिचानमुखी नारी पात्रहरूको उपस्थिति गराएर नारीपुरुषबिच द्वन्द्वको अवस्था सिर्जना गरेर आमूल नारीवादी विचारको अभिव्यक्ति गरिएको निष्कर्ष पनि यसमा निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: In Balkrishna Sama's play Swasnimanche, female characters occupy a central position. Female characters also appear in the leading roles of this play. Emerging from a background of patriarchal oppression, those female characters are also seen to be intensely rebellious against it. Therefore, having established a matriarchal realm, they have placed men in a subordinate position. Not only this, they even appear intent on altering the disposition of men and implanting feminine traits within them. It is within this context that the present research article has been prepared. Herein, an analysis of the play Swasnimanche has been conducted on the basis of radical feminist thought within feminist theoretical frameworks. Radical feminist doctrine regards patriarchy as the primary causal factor of the oppression of women. Within this work, the foundations of patriarchal oppression and female rebellion under radical feminist tenets are presented. On this very basis, the oppression endured by the female characters in the play Swasnimanche and the rebellion they staged against the background of that oppression are delineated in this article. The objective of this article is to seek a scholarly solution to the inquiry regarding what contexts of patriarchal oppression exist in the play Swasnimanche and how radical feminist ideology is articulated in the drama. Because this article is literary, materials were collected accordingly through library research and analyzed using an analytical method. The conclusion is also drawn that patriarchal oppression is presented at the outset of the social setting in the play Swasnimanche, and subsequently, by introducing rebellious and identity-conscious female characters and creating a state of conflict between women and men, radical feminist ideas are articulated.

In this paper, the foundations of patriarchal oppression and women's rebellion under radical feminist tenets have been set forth. On this basis, the oppression endured by the female characters of the play Swasnimanche and the revolt they mounted from the background of that oppression are delineated in the present article. The purpose of this paper is to seek an academic resolution to the question of what contexts of patriarchal oppression exist in the play Swasnimanche and how radical feminist ideas find expression within the play. The conclusion has also been reached herein that patriarchal oppression is presented at the outset of the social milieu of the play Swasnimanche, and thereafter, by introducing rebellious and identity-driven female characters and generating a state of conflict between women and men, radical feminist thought is given expression.
